sentences.text: Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

3. FIR in Crime No.314/2024 was registered by Electronic City Police Station, Bengaluru City,
against the petitioner herein initially for the offences punishable under Sections 417, 420, 376, 506 IPC on the basis of the first information dated 04.07.2024 received from the victim lady aged about 37 years.

entities.text: Electronic City Police Station, Bengaluru City
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: During the course of investigation of the case, petitioner was arrested and remanded to judicial custody on 13.07.2024.
Bail application filed by the petitioner before the jurisdictional Sessions Court was dismissed on 14.08.2024.
Therefore, he is before this Court.
4. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has no criminal antecedents.

The allegation against him is that he had sexual intercourse with the victim lady with NC:
2024:KHC:37782 a promise to marry her.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Accused nos.2 to 5 have been already enlarged on bail in the present case.

Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5.
Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.
6. The material on record would go to show that the petitioner and the victim lady who are both majors got acquainted to each other in Tamil Matrimonial website.
Subsequently, they developed intimacy and started meeting each other.
The allegation against the petitioner is that he had promised to marry the victim lady and taken her to various places and had sexual intercourse with her.
It is also alleged that petitioner who had promised to marry the victim lady, was delaying the marriage by giving false and lame excuses.
It is also alleged that petitioner had not only exploited the victim lady, but also had extracted money from her, and thereafter had cheated her.

It is in this Mr. Prasad R vs State By on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92673537/
2 background, the victim lady had approached the police.

sentences.text: Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Undisputedly, petitioner has no criminal antecedents.
The material on record would go to show that the victim had earlier filed a case in Crime No.112/2019 against one Vinay C.Musale and his relatives making similar allegations.
Considering the aforesaid aspects of the matter, I am of the opinion that petitioner's prayer for grant of regular bail is required to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following order:
8. The petition is allowed.
